items.title: NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope Launches
points: $4 billion mission lifted off aboard SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket, originally built as a National Reconnaissance Office spy satellite before NASA repurposed it in 2012

Can survey Milky Way far faster than Hubble telescope; expected to image more than 2 billion galaxies and build detailed 3D maps of tens of millions to study dark matter (invisible substance comprising 85% of universe's matter) and dark energy (mysterious force accelerating universe's expansion)

items.title: Jurassic-Era Soundscape Reconstructed
points: Researchers analyzed 20 fossilized wings from Jurassic crickets and katydids found in China to generate sounds from ~150 million years ago
Used AI modeling to predict insect calls based on ridges and spacing patterns preserved on wing structures, creating first scientifically-accurate soundscape of that prehistoric era

items.title: Intriguing Dark Matter Signal Detected
points: LZ Dark Matter Experiment buried 220+ meters underground in South Dakota recorded unusual particle interaction that doesn't match any known particle behavior

Only 1-in-400 statistical probability it's a random occurrence, making it one of the most compelling hints in decades-long hunt for dark matter, though physicists avoid definitive claims pending further confirmation

items.title: Medical Breakthroughs
points: Chinese scientists created self-exercising muscle grafts that contract continuously without physical effort in mice; improved muscle mass, bone density, endurance, and cognitive health; designed to help bedridden or elderly patients unable to exercise

Harvard-led trials: patients who lost average of 84% scalp hair took daily pill upadacitinib; within 24 weeks, ~50% achieved at least 80% scalp hair coverage by calming immune system overreaction attacking hair follicles

Doctors transplanted genetically engineered pig kidney into 66-year-old patient who avoided dialysis for 271 days; pig organs could serve as stopgap for hundreds of thousands of Americans awaiting donor kidneys
